recommendation.rationale: Sugarcane is 100% extracted locally on disk (2,521 images), has an ideal class balance (ratio 1.13x), 4 distinct major Indian diseases + healthy, in-field photographic fidelity, and zero unreadable images. While 210 exact duplicates must be pruned, it presents zero friction for immediate baseline modeling.
recommendation.second_choice_notes: Ideal for follow-up multi-class transfer learning once class weighting handles the 14.36x imbalance.
